coastline: Holds coastline geometries — one row per named coastline feature (grain: coastline feature) with name, geometry coastline_geom, and partitioning/cluster fields PARTITION and CLUSTER.
csa: Holds combined statistical area (CSA) entities; grain = one row per CSA (geo_id); keys/measures include csa_code, name, lsad_name, msa_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom, csa_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.

cbsa: Holds core-based statistical area (CBSA) entities; grain = one row per CBSA (geo_id); keys/measures include csa_geo_id, cbsa_fips_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, msa_indicator, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom, cbsa_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
adjacent_counties: Holds county adjacency lists; grain = one row per county (county, state); keys/measures include county_fips_code, neighbors (list of neighbor county names), neighbors_state (corresponding neighbor states), neighbors_fips_code (corresponding neighbor FIPS codes).
counties: Holds county entities; grain = one row per county (geo_id); keys/measures include state_fips_code, county_fips_code, county_gnis_code, county_name, lsad_name, lsad_code, fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, csa_fips_code, cbsa_fips_code, met_div_fips_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom, county_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
adjacent_states: Holds state adjacency lists; grain = one row per state (state); keys/measures include state_name, state_fips_code, neighbors_state (list of neighboring state names), neighbors_fips_code (corresponding neighbor FIPS codes).
metropolitan_divisions: Holds metropolitan division entities; grain = one row per metropolitan division (geo_id); keys/measures include csa_code, cbsa_code, metdiv_code, name, lsad_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_latitude, internal_point_longitude, internal_point_geom, metdiv_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
states: Holds state entities; grain = one row per state (geo_id); keys/measures include region_code, division_code, state_fips_code, state_gnis_code, state, state_name, lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom, state_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.

congress_district_<N>: Holds congressional district geometries for a given congress session (table per N); grain = one row per congressional district (geo_id); keys/measures include state_fips_code, district_fips_code, lsad_name, lsad_code, congress_session, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, int_point_lat, int_point_lon, int_point_geom, district_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
zip_codes: Holds ZIP Code Tabulation Areas; grain = one row per ZIP code area (zip_code); keys/measures include city, county, state_fips_code, state_code, state_name, fips_class_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lat, internal_point_lon, internal_point_geom, zip_code_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
nws_forecast_regions: Holds National Weather Service forecast region polygons/points; grain = one row per forecast region/zone (combination of state/cwa/zone); keys/measures include state, cwa, time_zone, fe_area, zone, name, state_zone, lon, lat, shortname, shape_geometry.
urban_areas: Entity: urban area definitions; Grain: one row per urban area (one geo_id/urban_area_code); Keys/measures: geo_id, urban_area_code, name, lsad_name, area_lsad_code, mtfcc_feature_class_code, type, functional_status, area_land_meters, area_water_meters, internal_point_lon, internal_point_lat, internal_point_geom, urban_area_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER
national_outline: Entity: national outline geometries; Grain: one row per outline record (one geo_id/aff_geo_id pair); Keys/measures: us_outline_geom, aff_geo_id, geo_id, name
